subject: Legacy secrets remediation and SDLC evidence for AtlasPay
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@atlaspay.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security@atlaspay.com
Date: 2026-10-04T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SDLC evidence + legacy secrets remediation plan

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. AtlasPay's security team is preparing for a scoped SIG/SOC2 spot check focused on secrets management and change control. We need a compact evidence bundle and a short remediation plan for legacy secrets that are not covered by our current ephemeral/KMS flows. Specifically, can you provide the following by EOD Oct 6 PST?

- A current inventory of "legacy" secrets (non-KMS, long-lived tokens) and the owners for each (CSV preferred).
- The CI/CD gating policy and evidence that PR enforcement is configured for repositories that deploy to production (screenshots or runbook excerpts).
- A short change-management timeline for rotating/remediating the top 10 highest-risk secrets and the verification steps you will use.
- Any supporting artifacts: runbooks, CI job logs (last 30 days), and the Jira ticket(s).

We can accept a staged delivery (inventory first, then runbook + diagrams). Please include a point of contact for follow-up with our auditor, SecAssure (third_party_auditor@secassure.io).

Thanks — we want to close this quickly.

Alice Nguyen
Security Program Manager | AtlasPay
alice.nguyen@atlaspay.com

[Attachment requested: evidence bundle (zip) — optional]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:05:30-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence + legacy secrets remediation plan

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask. We're on it. Summary of immediate plan below and first deliverable attached.

Attachments: secrets_inventory.csv (stub: list of legacy secrets, repo, owner, risk score)

Planned delivery cadence:
- 2026-10-04 (today): inventory (attached) + Jira ticket created for remediation (SUP-4821).
- 2026-10-05: CI/CD runbook excerpts and PR gating evidence; screenshots and job names.
- 2026-10-06: Final remediation timeline + verification instructions and zipped audit bundle.

Quick notes from the inventory: we identified ~37 long-lived tokens across infra and a few service accounts used by legacy sync jobs. We have triaged and labeled the top 10 by risk score; SUP-4821 contains the per-secret remediation actions.

Immediate owners and next steps:
- Monica will lead the rotation of infra tokens (cloud provider keys).
- Irene will assemble CI gating evidence and the runbook excerpts.
- Kimberly will diagram PR enforcement and the block rules we will enable.

Irene / Kim / Monica — please see the inventory and add your artifacts. Alice — I'll share the SUP ticket and Drive folder as we populate.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

[Attachment: secrets_inventory.csv]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@atlaspay.com>, security@atlaspay.com
Date: 2026-10-04T11:22:10-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence + legacy secrets remediation plan

Thanks Jordan — attaching the CI runbook excerpt and some verification pointers.

Attachments: ci_runbook.pdf (stub: sections included: PR gating checks, pipeline job names, artifact hashes, last-run timestamps)

Key items included in the runbook excerpt:
- PR gating: enforced branch protection on main with required status checks: "ci/unit-tests", "ci/integration-guard", and "ci/pr-enforcement". The "ci/pr-enforcement" job runs a policy check looking for hard-coded credentials using a secrets detector (scan:v2).
- CI logs: the runbook points to internal log buckets for the last 30 days (we'll include exported log samples in the bundle).
- Ephemeral credentials: note that for new services we require Vault/KMS-backed tokens; legacy sync jobs are on a remediation schedule.

Verification steps we will include for the auditor:
1) Screenshot of branch protection settings for repos identified in the inventory.
2) Export of recent CI job results for "ci/pr-enforcement" showing pass/fail and the remediation commits.
3) Runbook excerpt describing who approves a change (code owner + security reviewer) and how a change is promoted to production (canary -> gradual rollout).

@Monica — are you able to confirm the rotation windows for the top-10 list? I noted some tokens belong to third-party backups and will need coordination.

Irene Choi
Director, Applied Security | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Date: 2026-10-05T09:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence + legacy secrets remediation plan

Quick update — reviewed inventory and CI runbook. I've attached a simple diagram showing how PR enforcement will block merges that fail the secrets detector and the handoff to a security reviewer.

Attachments: pr_enforcement_diagram.png (stub: shows branch protection -> CI policy -> security-review step)

Planned enforcement timeline: enable strict blocking on a small set of repos (canary) on 2026-10-07, then expand the block list across prod repos over the week of 10/11. That will allow Monica's rotations to proceed without accidental redeployments.

Irene: I flagged the third-party backup tokens — will need short-lived credentials for the backup service or a migration window.

—Kimberly
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Jordan / team —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the artifacts so far. The inventory and runbook excerpts look good at a glance. A few follow-ups:

- Please add the exported CI job run (ci/pr-enforcement) for repo "sync-service" showing a clean run after remediation commits. A log snippet or job URL is fine.
- For the rotation timeline we need a target completion date for the top-10 high-risk secrets and a named verifier (someone from your security team) who will sign off.
- SecAssure will expect the final zipped audit bundle (inventory + runbook + diagrams + 3 CI job exports + SUP-4821 link) by end of day 2026-10-06 PST. Please send to security@atlaspay.com and cc third_party_auditor@secassure.io.

If you can confirm the completion target now, we'll mark this as an action in our intake tracker. Thanks — Alice
